description.value: Homestead Cookhouse is a comfort-food eatery at the Harbour Quay waterfront in Port Alberni, specializing in poutines loaded with smoked meats and homemade sauces unlike anywhere else. The menu extends to deluxe sandwiches on ciabatta, wraps, rice bowls, homemade chili, 6oz burgers, and Nathan all-beef hot dogs. Its location at Harbour Quay makes it a convenient and filling stop for cyclists moving through the Alberni Valley.
